notes.title: New patch live
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've patched our game today with some minor bug fixing, including one that wouldn't let players access the secret levels in chapter 5. Let us know if you find any others and happy puzzling to all!

notes.title: Salary Man Out Now!
notes.content:
Salary Man has just gone live on steam, go and lose yourself in the dark and puzzling world that is Salary Man Escape! 

And remember: you can quit your job but you can't quit your inner-Salary Man....

notes.content:
